0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting the Warriors at home. The Lakers have four players listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions: Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton and Jarred Vanderbilt. The Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, and Brandin Podziemski, Charles Bassey and Stephen Curry are day-to-day, also with game-time decisions. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win.
